name: Kokoro
source:
"I completely want to repay your kindness?"

The neighbor. A poker-faced little girl. She's always alone at home, even though she looks and acts very young. Her sense of smell is sharp, perhaps as an effect of wearing that doggy parka.

She stands out by the way she starts her sentences with "completely" and ends them with a question mark.

A tiny glass marble is her treasure. She likes canned coffee.

Favorite canned coffee: Busu [?]
